datasets.name: RTS inventory (fourth iteration)
datasets.verbatim: As the main data source for this study, we use the fourth iteration of the openly available RTS inventory from Nitze et al. [12] and Nitze [58]... It is available online at [58] and https://github.com/initze/ML_training_labels/.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Level 1C images
datasets.verbatim: Using the image footprints from the RTS inventory, we next download 83 matching Sentinel-2 Level 1C images sourced from Google Earth Engine.

methods.name: PixelDINO
methods.summary: A semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework that adopts the DINO self-distillation concept to the pixel level. It trains a student model to align its pixelwise predictions with a teacher model's outputs (pseudoclasses) under strong data augmentations, while simultaneously training on labeled data using a supervised loss.
methods.verbatim: The code is available online at: https://github.com/khdlr/PixelDINO.

code_links.name: PixelDINO project code and materials
code_links.summary: Custom code and supporting materials for the PixelDINO method, shared via a dedicated project page.

availability.author_statement: Full availability statement, with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked via a GitHub repository, and the Sentinel-2 imagery is accessible through Google Earth Engine. The custom PixelDINO code is provided via a persistent GitHub repository link.
